measurement: Consecutive day-end net liquidating equity at the same midnight convention, excluding external cash flows. Count fees, slippage, realized funding and protected positions held across midnight at an independently observable price, including modeled closing costs. Retain unrounded values, all dates, daily target hits, largest-trade and cost sensitivity. Do not convert leverage ROI, daily average or cumulative 60-day return into a passing daily result.
publication: A strategy may pass research promotion only if the daily net objective is reproduced separately and in its shared portfolio on sufficiently covered independent data under specified costs and risk. Keep retrospective discovery and prospective evidence distinct.
research: Revise entry filters, hours and combinations on development data. Register changes before observing the following interval. Track failed and underpowered attempts internally. Retain current 3–5x, 3 USDT reserve, 3 slots, per-order and portfolio risk and protection of existing positions. Continue searching for new patterns if existing families cannot cover costs. Enforce existing prospective sample-size, robustness, and release regression requirements; the daily goal replaces the old cumulative-only target.
freeze: First full unseen day is 2026-11-23 KST. 2026-09-23 through 2026-11-21 were observed earlier. No historical re-selection is independent evidence.
control: The prior tick-replayed 30-candle retest and heavy-volume long scalp, preserving each protective exit. Evaluate reversal long and short in their original hours, scalp in each fixed four-hour window, and each shared bundle.

filters.band_room: Favorable distance from entry quote to the last closed five-minute BB20 midpoint (reversal) or upper band (scalp) >= 3 times the modeled base round-trip fee plus slippage.
filters.room_and_close: band_room and volume-weighted average directional close location across the prior 3 completed active 1m bars >= 0.60; do not use incomplete bars.
filters.range_and_turnover: Median true range of the prior 8 completed 15m bars >= 3 base round-trip costs as a fraction of entry quote, latest completed 60m turnover proxy (sum of five-minute close times contract volume) >= 1.3 times preceding 60m, and the same directional close-location requirement.
